examples.label: Three-up feature row for a landing page
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-grid" site="Global" id="landing-feature-row" cols="three" gap="large">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-card" site="Global" padding="medium" rounded="large">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-card-title" site="Global" title="Drag, drop, publish" icon="hero-cursor-arrow-rays" />
    <.component component_name="chelekom-card-content" site="Global" class="text-sm opacity-80">Move blocks around until the page reads right. Nothing to install and nothing to compile.</.component>
  </.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-card" site="Global" padding="medium" rounded="large">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-card-title" site="Global" title="Fast on a phone" icon="hero-bolt" />
    <.component component_name="chelekom-card-content" site="Global" class="text-sm opacity-80">Pages ship as server-rendered HTML, so the first paint does not wait for a bundle.</.component>
  </.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-card" site="Global" padding="medium" rounded="large">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-card-title" site="Global" title="Every change kept" icon="hero-clock" />
    <.component component_name="chelekom-card-content" site="Global" class="text-sm opacity-80">Each save is a version you can read, compare and restore, down to a single paragraph.</.component>
  </.component>
</.component>
